coverage: 2000-present: structured Governor archive from 2019, plus 5 weather declarations added by hand by Governors Granholm and Snyder (2008-2018), from the former Governors' archive on michigan.gov (orders and press releases) and dated news coverage. No state declaration was found for DR-1346 (September 2000 flooding), EM-3160 (December 2000 snowstorm), DR-1413 (April 2002 flooding) or DR-1527 (May 2004 storms): the archive keeps no Engler records and no Granholm declaration for May 2004
